maria: Quick heads up — we're scheduling a phased rollout of driver + CUDA + NCCL across Dedicated h100 pools next Tue. I want a short fallback playbook for any perf/regression hits.

sanjay: Can you call out the exact variants? are we switching driver only or driver+cuda combo?

maria: Driver + CUDA combo. Targeting driver 535.48 + CUDA 12.2 + NCCL 2.19 on h100 pools. We'll do canary -> region-phased -> global.

shweta: Suggestion: 3 canary waves. 1) 2 nodes (internal), 2) 10% of a single region pool, 3) 33% across two regions. Each wave 30m ramp + 2h observation.

eli: For Dedicated customers we should avoid disruptive restarts. Plan to route new sessions to fallback nodes with pinned older driver. If a node needs rebooting, spin new nodes with old image and drain traffic to them.

maria: Agreed. Fallback options: a) automatic model-routing fallback (route to v532-compat) b) node-level fallback (image rollback) c) capacity fallback (steer traffic to dedicated-reserve pool). Pick a primary and secondary.

sanjay: Primary = automatic routing to v532-compat (same CUDA), Secondary = node image rollback. Add cost note: double-running reserved nodes during fallback will spike committed GPU-hours.

deploy-bot: Started canary job: canary/driver-535-cuda12.2-nccl2.19 @ h100-canary-01. ID: cj-20260318-01 :information_source:

shweta: Preflight checklist snippet (run on canary node):
```
# check GPU driver
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv
# cuda lib check
ldconfig -p | grep libcudart.so
# nccl version
python -c "import torch; import cupy; print('nccl', cupy.cuda.nccl.version())"
```
Run these before and after.

eli: Also capture perf baseline: p50/p95 latency for short gen and long gen, tokens/sec, KV cache hit ratio. Attach the perf suite: /infra/benchmarks/h100/dedicated/rolling_suite.yaml

maria: For observability: create ephemeral dashboards for the canary wave and alert on:
- latency p95 > baseline * 1.3
- error rate > 0.5% for 15m
- model output drift (eval set) > 2%

ops-oncall: Who is oncall for the rollout window? We need a 2hr overlap with infra oncall + eng-runtime.

sanjay: I'm taking lead for first wave. @eli you cover second wave. @shweta you own preflight and postmortem checklist. ops-oncall will escalate if alerts fire.

maria: Rollback playbook (short):
1) Pause rollout in control plane: set rollout.pause=true for canary cohort.
2) Switch routing policy to fallback variant: update service policy -> prefer=driver-532-compat (instant).
3) If still bad, enact node image rollback: spawn rollback-image with driver-532, cordon+drain affected nodes, attach new nodes.
4) If capacity degraded, enable cross-region spill to dedicated-reserve pool and notify customers.
Commands: 
```
# pause rollout
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" https://console.api/redwood/rollouts/cj-20260318-01/pause
# switch routing
redwoodctl route update --service inference --prefer driver-532-compat
# spawn rollback image
terraform apply -var='image=redwood-dedicated-driver-532' -target=module.h100_pool
```

shweta: Add communication templates: short incident note + customer-facing status blurb. Keep legal and sales in loop for Dedicated accounts.

eli: One gotcha: some older H100 hosts have custom kernel-opts for NVLINK. Preflight to detect kernel flags: `cat /proc/cmdline | grep nvlink` — if present tag node and exclude from canary.

maria: Good catch. Add node tagging rule: exclude nodes with tag `nvlink-legacy` from canaries.

ops-oncall: I'll create the temporary alert channel #rollout-driver-535 and add hooks to PagerDuty escalation.

sanjay: Timeline: Tue 10:00 PT start canary-1, 10:45 decide go/no-go, 13:00 start canary-2 if green. Rollout doc will be in /docs/rollouts/driver-535-playbook.md (I'll author).

maria: Final ask: everyone add their final checklist items by EOD today. If no blockers, we ship the canary manifest tomorrow morning to staging. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary job complete: canary/driver-535-cuda12.2-nccl2.19 @ h100-canary-01 -> success (smoke tests passed). Logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/cj-20260318-01/logs

shweta: Running full perf suite now. ETA ~45m. Will post results in this thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eli: Noted — I'll prep rollback image in parallel so node rollout is <30m if needed.

sanjay: Thanks all. Keep replies short in this thread so we can copy into the playbook.

shweta: Perf results: short-gen p95 +8% (within threshold), long-gen tokens/sec -2%, errors 0.12%. No drift on eval set. Marking canary-1 green.

maria: Great. Proceed with canary-2 at 13:00 PT per plan.

ops-oncall: Channel #rollout-driver-535 created and PD escalation set.

sanjay: Adding final note: cost tradeoff reminder — if we hit fallback and keep reserve pool for >4h, finance should be notified (cc @finance).

maria: End of day checklist collected. Thanks team.
